pr.title: [Experimental] Qwen 3.5 block: the Qwen3.8-27B dense attention layer as a validated member and the packed K|V pool binding (kv_layout="UNIFIED")
pr.body:
## 📌 Description

> Follows #6573 (the Qwen 3.5 gated attention block for Rubin) and #7983 (the cuDNN Frontend `4c8e24355` re-vendor of the shared tree):
> this change adds two things to the Qwen 3.5 block package -- the **Qwen3.8-27B dense attention layer** as a validated member of the
> block (cells at the shapes a serving stack hands over, on all three forms), and the **packed K|V pool binding** `kv_layout="UNIFIED"`
> (ONE `[num_pages, H_kv, page_size, 2 x D]` tensor per layer, bound as two half views).  No kernel, no vendored file and no signature
> changes; the cuDNN Frontend pin stays `4c8e24355` (the tree already declares the pool layout); the Qwen 3.8 package is untouched.

**The member.** One block, members by geometry: the kernels serve every GQA geometry at head dim 256 that passes the geometry gate
(`d_model % 256 == 0`, `rope_dim` 64 or 128), and the tests pin the family's rows.  New here is the Qwen3.8-27B dense attention layer
at TP 1 -- `d_model` 5120, 24 query / 4 KV heads x 256, `rope_dim` 64 (a quarter of the head), `qk_norm_eps` 1e-6; `n_qkvg` 14336, GQA
group 6 -- the geometry row cuDNN Frontend `4c8e24355` pins in its own layout contract and family table (NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend#1471).
No gate declined the geometry (the envelope admitted it, and the vendored tree serves it on cc 10.7 with all three forms), so nothing
is lifted; what lands are the cells that pin it and the typed declines around it: `rope_dim` 32 / 192 / 256, `head_dim` 128, a
`d_model` off the projection tile (5000) -- declined by the probe and by `prepare` before any vendored code --, 33 decode rows (the
decode envelope), f16 (the dtype gate).  The decode cells assert the routes the vendored single-unit table claims for group 6 on cc
10.7: `q_len` 1 -> the packed d256 decode tile at 16 columns, one token unit, claimed; `q_len` 4 -> 32 columns, one unit, claimed; one
KV stream; the KV write-through folded into the norm + RoPE launch (the split count is batch-dependent and not pinned).  The README's
new "Members served" section states the same (one block, members by geometry; the validated shapes of this member; no performance
number claimed).

**The binding.** `kv_layout="UNIFIED"` is the serving stacks' packed K|V pool: ONE bf16 `[num_pages, H_kv, page_size, 2 x D]` tensor
per layer with K in columns `[0, D)` and V in `[D, 2D)` of every row (the 24 / 4 model family's `[pages, 4, 16 or 32, 512]` cache),
bound as its two half views `kv[..., :D]` / `kv[..., D:]` by strides -- no copy, no repack; on a contiguous pool both views carry
strides `(H_kv x page_size x 2D, page_size x 2D, 2D, 1)`, the V base `D` elements past the K base.  It is the vendored tree's
`unified` pool layout (`SERVING_POOL_LAYOUTS` = `hnd` / `nhd` / `unified`, declared since NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend#1606 / #1619 and pinned
on the paged serving forms by NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend#2057).  Every public entry accepts the spelling with no signature change
(`prepare_qwen_3_5_block_bf16`, `qwen_3_5_block_bf16_prefill` / `_extend` / `_decode`, `Qwen35BlockWrapper(kv_layout=...)`);
`plan.kv_layout` / `plan.declaration["kv_layout"]` read back `"UNIFIED"`; the functional entry points read the page size off the
pool's `page_size` axis.  The pool contract is checked host-side and typed before any launch (`D` contiguous, every other stride a
16-byte multiple, 16-byte-aligned bases, the exact trailing shape `[H_kv, page_size, 2D]`, the dtype); a 5-D `[num_pages, 2, ...]`
buffer or a `(k, v)` pair under this spelling is refused and pointed at the spelling it binds under (`kv_layout="NHD"` / `"HND"`), and
the unknown-layout message names the three spellings.  `check_vendored_rules()` gains the `pool_layouts` fact -- the vendored
`SERVING_POOL_LAYOUTS` against `KV_LAYOUTS` lowercased; a drift is the loud `RuntimeError`, as for every mirrored rule.

**One word, two stacks.** The Qwen 3.8 sibling package (#7136) spells ITS stack's packed row -- the NHD-ordered
`[num_pages, page_size, H_kv, 2 x D]` -- with the same word `"UNIFIED"`.  The binding is the same (K at `+0`, V at `+D` of one row), the
axis order is each stack's own; `support.py`, the `api.py` docstrings and the README state it next to the layout table so a reader of
both packages is not misled.  The 3.8 package is not changed (its README stays byte-identical to its docs copy).

**Appended surface (append-only).** `support.KV_LAYOUTS` gains `"UNIFIED"` (last), `support.KV_LAYOUT_UNIFIED`, `support.KV_LAYOUT_SHAPES`
(one cache-tensor shape per spelling), `Qwen35BlockSupport.kv_layout_shapes` (the last field; `qwen_3_5_block_support(...).kv_layouts`
now reads the three spellings); `api.kv_views_unified` (in `api.__all__`), `api.kv_views(..., kv_layout="UNIFIED")` dispatches to it.
README and its docs copy (identical edits): "Members served", the vLLM-shaped sample's 27B line and packed-pool comment, the `kv_cache`
bullet, the three-spelling table, the Errors row for malformed packed pools, the GQA groups (24 / 4), Validation; the facade docstrings
name the spelling.

## 📈 Performance

No performance number is claimed: this change carries the functional claim only (the member's cells, the binding, the parity).  The
packed pool is BITWISE the two-tensor HND pool holding the same bytes -- on `out` and on both pool halves on the decode form, on `out`
on the extend form -- because the same kernels read and write the same bytes through other strides.  The per-layer measurement of the
27B member on an exclusive 212-SM-class part is owed separately.

## 🔍 Related Issues

Follows #6573 (the Qwen 3.5 block), #7136 / #7594 (the Qwen 3.8 sibling at decode) and #7983 (the `4c8e24355` re-vendor of the shared
tree); the package's experimental lifecycle is tracked in #6805.  The cuDNN Frontend side: NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend#1471 (the Qwen3.8 family
geometries pinned in the layout contract -- the 27B row), #1606 / #1619 (the serving EXTEND / DECODE forms and their pool layouts,
`unified` among them), #2057 (a serving stack's packed K|V cache rows pinned on the paged serving forms: cells + docs).

## 🚀 Pull Request Checklist

### ✅ Pre-commit Checks

- [x] `pre-commit` hooks pass on every hand-written file of this change (ruff format / check, mypy, the SPDX and file hooks) -- run on
  the eight files at the final head, after the merge with `main`.
- [x] No change outside `flashinfer/experimental/qwen_3_5_block/` (`support.py`, `api.py`, `README.md`), `flashinfer/qwen_3_5_block.py`,
  `docs/experimental/qwen_3_5_block.md` and `tests/experimental/qwen_3_5_block/`; no vendored file, no kernel, no signature change.

| `tests/experimental/qwen_3_8_block/` (the shared tree's other consumer; untouched) | 103 | SM107 GPU (shared) | **103 passed, 0 skipped** |

The Qwen 3.5 gated attention block package now serves the Qwen3.8-27B dense attention layer (24 query heads / 4 KV heads x 256, d_model 5120, rope dim 64) as a validated member: 14 cells at that geometry (decode at pages 16 / 32 and batch 1 / 4, extend behind a prefix, prefill) against the module's oracle at its existing bound, and the serving stack's packed K|V pool bound as two half views (KV_LAYOUTS gains UNIFIED, append-only; bitwise the HND twin).
